title: Iterable User
description: A user profile in the Iterable marketing automation platform. Users are the primary audience for campaigns and represent contacts that can receive messages across email, push, SMS, and in-app channels.

email.description: The primary email address of the user, used as the default unique identifier

userId.description: An alternative unique identifier for the user, set by the integrating application

signupDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the user was first created in Iterable

profileUpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent profile update

dataFields.description: Custom data fields stored on the user profile, used for segmentation and personalization

phoneNumber.description: Phone number in E.164 format for SMS messaging

emailListIds.description: IDs of the email lists the user is subscribed to

unsubscribedChannelIds.description: IDs of channels the user has unsubscribed from

unsubscribedMessageTypeIds.description: IDs of message types the user has unsubscribed from

devices.description: Mobile and web devices registered to the user for push notifications

Device.description: A device registered for push notifications

token.description: The device push token (APNs or FCM)

endpointEnabled.description: Whether the push endpoint is currently active

dataFields.description: Custom data fields associated with the device
